item.title: North Bay man charged with theft after commercial vehicle stolen from downtown
item.description: The North Bay Police Service arrested a North Bay man after a commercial vehicle was stolen from a downtown property. Police responded to a report of a stolen vehicle Tuesday in the 500 block of Main Street East. The accused entered a commercial vehicle that had been left running at a job site and drove […]

item.title: SIU clears officers who shot man after days-long manhunt in Latchford
item.description: The Special Investigations Unit concludes that the two officers who shot an armed, military-trained, and mentally ill man did so lawfully.

item.title: NBPS not partaking in the Assault-Style Firearms Compensation Program
item.description: Like many other police services, the North Bay Police Service is not going to participate in the Assault-Style Firearms Compensation Program citing the lack of structured operational framework outlining roles, responsibilities, and program requirements.
